motivation: The supported pre-loss local legacy signal remains after stable-node and community-state controls. Test whether that history signal is still present when the focal-loss year becomes completely seagrass-bare, removing immediate community-continuity as an explanation.

prerequisite.history_definition: same uninterrupted pre-loss Thalassia run length as preloss_local_legacy_v1

primary_population.sequence_rule: same frozen 259 three-year exact-point recovery sequences

predictor.name: pre_loss_run_length
predictor.definition: number of immediately consecutive consensus years ending in the source year with Thalassia recorded present at the same point; stop at first missing or absent year

model.outcome: Thalassia recorded present at the same meter mark in recovery year
model.scaling: StandardScaler for numeric predictors inside each fit

uncertainty.method: stable-node cluster bootstrap with all bare-state sequences from sampled nodes travelling together
uncertainty.support_rule: 95% bootstrap interval for standardized centered run-length coefficient entirely above zero

secondary_descriptive: return versus non-return run-length medians within the bare subgroup

interpretation.supported: A pre-loss local history signal remains even when the loss-year point is seagrass-bare, consistent with focal local legacy or persistent microsite structure beyond immediate community continuity.
interpretation.unsupported: The pre-loss history signal does not remain robust among seagrass-bare loss-year points; the overall legacy association may depend on vegetated habitat continuity and/or broader site quality.

claim_boundary: Post-hoc subgroup audit of an already-opened recovery and history endpoint.
A positive bare-state history effect would still not identify residual rhizomes, clonal integration, habitat quality, or detection persistence separately.
Return is recorded reappearance at the same meter mark, not genet-level recolonization.
The bare subgroup, run-length definition, node-centering, covariates, regularization, bootstrap unit, minima, and support threshold are frozen before opening this subgroup coefficient.
Do not relax minima or pool vegetated loss-year points back into the primary if the bare audit is non-estimable or unsupported.
